name: Climate.Pid → Set Deadband Threshold Parameters
description: This action sets runtime deadband threshold values for the PID controller. This can be used to manually tune the deadband zone. Make sure to update the values you want in the YAML file! They will reset on the next reboot.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: ID of the PID Climate to update.

config_entries.label: Threshold High
config_entries.description: Upper deadband threshold relative to the target temperature.

config_entries.label: Threshold Low
config_entries.description: Lower deadband threshold relative to the target temperature. It must be less than or equal to `threshold_high`.
